verdict.rationale: The only non-interactive channel in evidence is EFILE: enrolled electronic filers use CRA-certified tax software to transmit returns system-to-system, including amended returns via ReFILE (cra-supp-3, cra-docs-14, cra-docs-15, cra-docs-19). It is gated behind certification and enrollment with an EFILE number and password, and covers only return filing. Everything else, including business registration, payments and document submission, is described as interactive online portal use. Missing for 10: a public API or CLI usable by ordinary users, CI/headless documentation, automation coverage beyond certified-software return transmission, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
